Commentary.Commentary: That is it from the 'Gabba then. Australia showed why they are ranked the best ODI team in the world today while Pakistan showed, well, they were just Pakistan, letting the match slip after having it in control. They do not have much time to turn around as the second ODI will be played at the MCG on Sunday, 15th January, 2017 at 0850 IST (0320 GMT). Do join us then. In the meanwhile, do have a look at the SA-SL Test at the Wanderers. We are wandering off now. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious Aussie captain, STEVEN SMITH admits that it was an average start with the bat for Australia. Feels that the batsmen were in a bit of a hurry. Praises Wade for scoring his maiden ODI hundred. Adds that 270 was around par, given the conditions and was confident that Australia could restrict Pakistan to below that. On the batting depth, he says that the Aussies have a long batting line-up, as much as till Mitchell Starc at 10. Still, feels that it was not used properly today and wants his batsmen to play their shots in a more controlled manner. Praises his bowling unit for bowling beautifully.

Pakistan skipper, AZHAR ALI says his hamstring is a bit sore. But hopes that he recovers soon. Says that the physios will have a look and will pass their judgement on whether he can take part in the next game or not. Credits his bowlers for a superb bowling performance at the start. After getting Australia 5 down for 78, he suggests that they should have had them out earlier. But thinks the target was also chaseable. Adds that it was very hot and tiring to field under the sun and chase the ball on these long outfields.

MATTHEW WADE has been named the Man Of The Match for his run-a-ball century. He says that it is a great feeling to have scored a century. Praises Pakistan for putting the Aussie top order in early trouble. Credits Glenn Maxwell for accelerating the scoring and adds that the partnership with him gave Wade confidence. On his century in the last over, he says that he was not paying attention to his milestone till he reached 93 and then threw his bat around. Says that the Aussies were confident that they can defend 268 given their bowling attack. On the pickle juice which is used to treat hamstring issues, he says that it does not taste that good, albeit his skipper Smith likes the taste.

Earlier in the afternoon, Australia escaped embarrassment. All their batsmen were in a hurry to get runs and ended up throwing their wickets away. They were tottering at 78/5 and then 170/7 but Pakistan missed a golden opportunity to restrict the Aussies under 200. It was a different Glenn Maxwell today, playing a bit more responsibly while Matthew Wade has shown that the tradition of a good wicket-keeper batsman is still strong with his terrific century. He first formed a stand with Maxwell and then a crucial one with Cummins to take the hosts to safety. Stay tuned for the presentation.

A decent outing with the ball for Australia. Billy Stanlake did not have the greatest of ODI debuts but the others did well. Starc bowled with swing and zeal and picked up 2 wickets while Cummins bowled with sheer pace, taking 3 scalps. Faulkner and Mitchell Marsh were brilliant. Personally feel that Marsh could have got more than just one wicket while Faulkner ended up with 4. How good was Travis Head? No wickets, but 0/28 in 10 overs is gold dust on any pitch.

The visitors were never in the run chase though. Sharjeel and Azhar did the correct part by seeing off the new balls. But then, the former's wicket spelt trouble. Azhar then injured his hamstring and next, Hafeez went cheaply. After that, there was some intent shown as Umar Akmal tried to counter-attack but once he went, it was just a mere formality.

An easy victory in the end for the home side. The scorecard does not show it though. When you see a team winning by 92 runs, it means the victor has dominated proceedings. Yes, but Pakistan did have their chances.

OUT! The pain is over. AUSTRALIA HAVE WON BY 92 RUNS. A length ball outside off, Riaz backs away and slashes hard but only gets a top edge. Mitchell Starc runs to his left and takes a simple catch at mid off. The game is finally over after dawdling along for so long.
On a good length around off, cutting in, worked through mid on for a run.
A full toss outside off, swatted down to long on for a single.
Full on middle, swinging in, Riaz looks to whip it through the leg side but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball ricochets past the off stump behind.
On middle and off, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.

Full and wide outside off, Wahab miscues this over cover where Steven Smith leaps to his right but the ball evades him. Perhaps the ball hit his hand while going through. A single taken. You can count it as a DROP though some will not agree.
HASAN ALI is the last man in.

OUT! Faulkner gets his fourth! This was coming. Smart bowling, another slower delivery, from the back of the hand, full and outside off, Amir looks to go over the top but miscues it towards cover. Glenn Maxwell settles under it near the 30-yard circle and pouches it. The match almost is over now. I mean officially.
Full and wide outside off, Mohammad backs away and slashes hard. Ends up slicing it over point and gets a couple.
Full and around off, Riaz goes down on a knee and slogs it to long on for a run.
Short and outside off, Amir throws his bat at it and mistimes his cut shot towards cover for a single.
Full and outside off, Riaz looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Excellent yorker outside off, dug out back to the bowler.

Full and wide outside off, Mohammad throws his bat at it but is beaten by the change in pace. Skews this over cover but it trisects the fielder running back from the ring and two more coming in - deep cover and long off. Almost like a triangle. Two runs taken.
On a good length outside leg, Amir backs away and tries to steer it to third man but misses. The ball goes over the stumps and dies on its way to Matthew Wade.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single. Riaz wants the second but is sent back.
WAHAB RIAZ walks in at number 10, replacing Azhar. In the meanwhile, PAT CUMMINS comes back on to bowl.
POWERPLAY 3 has been signalled. 5 fielders allowed outside the circle now. As if it matters. Australia might want to keep all 9 inside the 30-yard circle now.

OUT! THE SKIPPER DEPARTS! The dropped chance doesn't cost much! Slower delivery on a length, Ali looks to slog it but gets beaten by the lack of pace. The ball balloons off the top edge towards deepish square leg. Warner from deep square leg comes running in and takes the catch on the slide. Another good catch from Warner! Faulkner gets his 3-fer! AUSTRALIA NEED 2 MORE WICKETS TO WIN!
DROPPED! Fuller on the stumps, Ali hits it hard straight back. Faulkner looks to grab it on his followthrough but fails to hold onto it.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot through mid off for a single.
Full outside off, Amir scoops it over covers. Falls a little short of Warner. A single is completed!
Back of a length delivery, punched off the back foot through covers for a single.
Angling across the southpaw, Amir goes for a wild slog but misses it completely.
Length delivery outside off, cut through point for a single.
Ali shuffles and looks to scoop it but misses. Is lucky that the ball went over the stumps.
MOHAMMAD AMIR walks in at number 9, replacing Wasim.

OUT! WASIM DEPARTS! Marsh bangs it short, Wasim pulls it but fails to connect it cleanly. Mistimes it high in the air towards mid-wicket. Warner is the man present at deep mid-wicket and he comes running in and grabs it with his safe pair of hands. Now it's the start of tail. AUSTRALIA NEED 3 WICKETS MORE TO WIN!
On a length on the stumps, Wasim shuffles and looks to scoop but misses.
Short delivery outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, worked down the leg side for a single.
Fuller around off, driven to mid off.

IN THE AIR... BUT SAFE!On the fuller side of the length. It's a slower one. Wasim is beaten by the lack of pace on it and checks his shot at the last moment. The ball balloons high in the air towards covers but no one's present there. The batsmen run through for a single.
Fullish on the stumps, Ali lofts it over mid on for a single.
Angling towards the pads, Ali looks to tuck it but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad. The ball then goes near the first slip of a spinner. Ali want a single but Wasim isn't interested.
Angling across Ali, he guides it straight to short third man.
JAMES FAULKNER comes back on. Can Australia finish this off?
Back of a length delivery, pulled through mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Length delivery outside off, IW guides it fine through the third man region for a boundary. FIRST BOUNDARY AFTER THE 19TH OVER!
Another short delivery, pulled through square leg for a single.
Length delivery wide outside off, Wasim slashes through point for a single.
Short again, Wasim pulls it through backward square leg. Stanlake chases from fine leg and slides in to stop the ball. A couple taken!
Short delivery, pulled through front of square on the leg side for a single.
MITCHELL MARSH is back on!
On the pads, tucked fine on the leg side for a single. Another tight over! HEAD FINISHES WITH A FIGURE OF 10-0-28-0!
Flatter one on the stumps, Ali looks to play it across the line but gets a leading edge into the ground and back to the bowler.
Shortish delivery, punched off the back foot through cover-point for a single.
Served on middle and leg, clipped to mid-wicket.
On the pads, flicked straight on the leg side.
Fuller on the stumps, driven straight back.
Low full toss on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery around off, Wasim defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Wasim looks to guide it but misses.
Full outside off, Wasim bends his knees and drives through point for a brace.
Low full toss outside off, driven to mid off.
Length delivery outside off, tapped to point.

LBW SHOUT! Sliding away from Ali, he kneels down and looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. There's a huge appeal but the umpire isn't interested. The Hawk Eye shows that the impact was umpire's call and was going on to miss the stumps.
Shortish delivery outside off, punched off the back foot through cover-point for a single.
Darted on the stumps, AA clips through mid-wicket for a single.
On middle and leg, played to mid-wicket.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
Shortish delivery and wide outside off, Wasim cuts it through point for a single.
Full and angling in, AA clips it through mid-wicket. Ali limps through for a brace.
AZHAR ALI has walked back in!

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! STARC SPECIAL! Full outside off, swinging in after pitching, Nawaz goes for an expansive shot. Is beaten by pace completely and the ball goes on to strike the off pole. Nawaz has to walk back! AUSTRALIA 4 WICKETS AWAY FROM VICTORY!
Length delivery, straightening a touch, Nawaz defends off the upper half of his bat.
Wide! Full and angling down leg, Nawaz looks to clip but misses. Wade appeals to distract the umpire but the umpire signals it a wide.
Another yorker! This time Nawaz manages to get some bat on it.
Yorker, into the pads, Nawaz looks to clip it but misses and is hit low on the pads. There's a mild appeal for LBW but no one is really convinced and the umpire says not out.
Angling into the batsman, defended off the back foot.
MITCHELL STARC has been brought back on!
On the stumps, spinning away a touch, Nawaz looks to turn it across the line but gets a leading edge towards covers. They run through for a single.
Quicker one outside leg, Nawaz looks to flick it but misses and gets rapped up on the pads.
Shortish delivery, going on with the arm, IW goes back and punches off the back foot through point for a single.
Sliding into the pads, Wasim looks to play it across the line but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Sliding into the pads, worked to leg side.
Outside off, Wasim defends it off the front foot.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under it!
Length delivery, directed towards the body of the batsman, defended off the back foot.
Wasim guides it with the angle through to third man for a single.
Length delivery, angling away, Wasim chops it to point.
Short and angling across, left alone.
New batsman in is MOHAMMAD NAWAZ.

OUT! BREAK DOES THE TRICK! CUMMINS HAS HIS SECOND! Back of a length delivery outside off, Rizwan looks to pull it but the ball goes off the top edge. Mitchell Marsh at deep mid-wicket runs in towards his left. Keeps his eyes on the ball and tries to take it with a reverse cup. Fumbles on the first attempt but doesn't lose his concentration. And then grabs it with one hand on the second attempt! Good catch in the end! Pakistan need something special now! AUSTRALIA NOW 5 WICKETS SHY OF VICTORY! Remember, Azhar Ali is retired hurt!
Rizwan is being treated after a Warner's throw from the deep hit him directly on the shin. Pakistan wouldn't want another injury blow.
Full and down the leg side, Rizwan looks to clip but fails. The ball goes off the pads fine down the leg side. Leg bye taken.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Short and outside off, eased through the covers for a single.

TOP EDGE, SAFE! Full on middle, Rizwan looks to play the sweep but gets a top edge which does not carry to David Warner at fine leg. The throw came in at the bowler's end and hit Rizwan on his left shin instead. Poor Rizwan was hobbling.
Full on middle, defended watchfully.
Short and outside off, slapped to deep cover for a single. Moves to 10 from 9 balls.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Top edge, safe! A short ball on middle, Wasim looks to pull but gets a top edge. Does not carry to fine leg. A single taken.
Outside off, let through once more.
Landed outside off, angled away, left alone.
SIX! Welcome back into the attack! Full and straight, Wasim stands tall and lofts this straight back over the sight screen!
PAT CUMMINS is back on.
This time he takes it on the full and scoops it over Wade once more for another brace.
Full on middle, Mohammad gets down and paddles it over the keeper for a couple.
Comes down the track and drives it to cover-point.
Landed around off, Rizwan defends it watchfully.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Full and on the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
TRAVIS HEAD is back on.
On middle, Rizwan drives it wide of mid on. Travis Head gives it a good chase from mid on and slides near the boundary to pull it back in. Two runs taken.
Full and wide outside off, Wasim looks to drive but gets a bottom edge to third man. A single taken.
Landed around off, defended watchfully.
Landed outside off, steered to third man for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On a good length outside off, played straight to point.
On a good length outside off, angling away, steep bounce, let through.
IMAD WASIM walks in at number 6, replacing Azam.

OUT! Straight to the man! Cummins gets his man. On a good length outside off, Azam tries to be too cheeky, aiming to run this down to third man but ends up guiding it straight to Steven Smith at first slip. It seemed like the action was happening in slow motion. It went that slowly. Azam wastes his start then. 160 MORE NEEDED FROM 145 BALLS. Extra bounce did him in.
And now an inside edge. Azam drives this without moving his feet and gets a thick inside edge, just past leg stump to fine leg. A couple of runs taken. The stand moves to 30 from 53 balls.
Landed outside off, Mohammad chops it onto the ground, over a leaping Steven Smith at first slip to third man. Takes the single.
Full again, driven towards mid off now.
A double bluff. Cummins bowls a full one outside off, Rizwan drives through the covers but Chris Lynn dives to his right to stop the ball.
PAT CUMMINS is back into the attack now. No protection down the ground, which suggests it is going to be short and at the body.
This one tails in as well, Mohammad looks to defend but the ball goes off the inside edge towards square leg. A run taken.
This one nips back in sharply, from outside off, Rizwan hops to defend but misses and is hit on the pads.
On a good length outside off, Azam plays this very late, with soft hands to third man for one.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
Full and slightly wider outside off, Rizwan looks to drive but the feet do not move much. Misses.
Short and outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a single. Moves to 30 from 43 balls.
Full and straight, Rizwan plays a late paddle sweep to get it fine. The bowler and keeper go up in an appeal but it dies down quickly. Two runs taken.
On middle, pushed down to long on for a run. 169 more needed from 157 balls now.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Full on middle, Babar drives it towards long on but Head dives to his right to stop the ball.
Comes down the track, Head shortens the length, Azam has to push it to short third man.
Full and down the leg side, paddled down to fine leg for a single.
ALMOST CHOPS IT ON! Outside off, Azam looks to run it down to third man but gets a bottom edge which goes over the stumps to the keeper!
Full and wide outside off, Azam drives a touch loosely and the ball goes off the outside edge past point. David Warner tidies up from sweeper cover and the batsmen take a couple.
A short ball again, pulled to fine leg for a run.
A short ball on middle, pulled through square leg for a single.
Full and straight, driven straight down the ground.
Landed on off, pushed to the off side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On middle and off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
ALMOST CARRIED! Full and on middle, Rizwan looks to paddle but ends up hitting it towards square leg. Glenn Maxwell at short backward square leg dices but the ball lands in front.
A short ball down the leg side, helped towards fine leg for a single.
Full and on the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Landed around off, Rizwan tries to play it with a straight bat but gets squared up due to the late movement. Edges it to third man and gets a single.
On middle and off, defended back to the bowler.
A length ball outside off, MR slashes but misses.
Bends his back again, lands it on middle and off, Mohammad jumps to tuck it to the leg side. Got a bit uncomfortable there.
On a good length outside off, extra bounce, Rizwan dabs it to point.
MITCHELL MARSH has been given the ball now.
Sliding towards the stumps from leg, Rizwan works it past leg gully for a single.
Darted in on middle and leg, blocked it out.
A slight field change. Maxwell moves to leg gully.
Outside leg, Azam works it through square leg for a single.
Leg bye! On the pads, Rizwan gets down the track and looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off the pads, goes through to fine leg. A leg bye is taken!
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.

Down the leg side, swept fine down the leg side. Stanlake from fine leg comes running in towards his right and cuts it out. The batsmen run through for a couple. Good seeing Stanlake back on the field and up and running!
On the fuller side of the length, pushed to mid off.
Length delivery on the stumps, defended off the back foot.
Another play and a miss! Slightly fullish outside off, shaping in, Azam looks to drive it on the up but misses.
FOUR! On the pads, tickled it very fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, Azam looks to guide it but the ball rises a touch extra and beats him. Excellent delivery!
Full and wide outside off, Rizwan also looks to drive it but the ball goes off the outside edge to third man. Rizwan picks up a single.
Sliding away from Azam, turned to square leg. Another good tight over by Head. Just 2 runs of it!
Fuller on the pads, blocked on the leg side.
Flatter and quicker on the stumps, defended on the leg side.
Off the mark! Fuller on the stumps, driven through to long on for a single.
Served fuller on middle and leg, driven through mid on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On middle and off, searching for a yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss. Driven to mid on.
MOHAMMAD RIZWAN is the new man to walk in!

OUT! STARC DOES THE TRICK! Short delivery, rises onto Akmal, he pulls it but pulls it straight to Head at mid on. Akmal tried to attack Starc but ended up giving him his wicket. Starc has the last laugh, is delighted and gives a send off to Akmal. AUSTRALIA NEED 7 WICKETS MORE TO WIN!
Full and wide outside off, Azam looks to slash it but the ball flies off the outside edge through to third man for a single.
Fuller on the pads, UA clips it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Low full toss on the stumps, flicked past Head at mid on for a boundary.
Akmal tries to take on Starc but misses! Length delivery, angling across, Akmal charges and looks to go big but ends up swinging the bat at nothing.
Fuller on middle and leg, Akmal makes room and drives it hard past the bowler. Head tries to stop it but fails and the ball goes to long on. A single is taken!
On the pads, worked on the leg side.
Flatter and shorter, punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
FALLS SHORT! Slower through the air, on the pads. The ball holds a touch after pitching. Azam checks his shot and chips it uppishly but falls just short of Smith at short mid-wicket.
On the pads, defended to forward square leg.
Served full outside off, driven to deepish mid off. No runs taken!
Spin is introduced as TRAVIS HEAD is brought into the attack!
Fullish on the stumps, defended off the front foot to mid on.
Back of a length delivery, Umar drag-pulls it through square leg for a brace.
Full on off stump, pushed to mid off.

FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Akmal swings his bat and swings it hard. Fortune favours him and the ball flies off the outside edge past first slip. Reaches the third man fence in a flash. A boundary is signalled!
Fires in full on middle and leg, blocked neatly by Umar. Intentions are clear from Starc. He is going to bowl it full and fast!
Back of a length delivery, shaping in a touch, defended to covers from within the crease.
MITCHELL STARC is back into the attack!
On a length and outside off, cut to point.
Length delivery, angling in, defended from within the crease.
Banged in short, Azam ducks under it to let it sail through.
Full outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full outside off in the block hole, Azam taps it through to third man for a single.

DECISION STAYS! TWO LEG BYES! Fuller on the pads, Akmal shuffles a touch and looks to tickle it around the corner but misses and the ball goes off the pads towards long stop. The batsmen take a couple of leg byes. However, Smith decides to review it after being suggested by Faulkner. The Hawk Eye shows that the ball has pitched outside leg and the case is over there itself.
Review taken by Australia for an LBW decision against Akmal given as not out!
FOUR! Akmal loses his patience, takes the aerial route and is successful in getting off the mark. Fuller on middle and off, mistimely lofted over mid on. Still, the ball reaches the fence.
On the pads, clipped through forward square leg. The ball has been stopped just before the fence. Three runs taken! Good running!
Full on off, pushed to mid off.
Angling across Azam, defended from within the crease.
FOUR! Straight down the ground! Full on the stumps, Azam drives it straight down the ground, past Faulkner, who dives to his left but fails to stop. The ball crosses the ropes in a flash!
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. Just a run off the over!
Back of a length delivery outside off, UA defends it solidly.
Just short of a good length, tapped to point.
Length delivery, angling in, defended with a straight bat from within the crease.
Full outside off, Azam leans into the shot and drives it through covers. Warner from mid off chases it and saves a run for his team. Three runs taken!
On a length and outside off, Azam opts to leave it.
Akmal stays in the crease and defends. WICKET MAIDEN BY FAULKNER!
On the pads, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery, punched off the back foot to short cover.
On the fuller side of the length on middle and off, defended from within the crease.
Angling away from Akmal, he looks to play it with the angle but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
UMAR AKMAL is the new man in.

OUT! FAULKNER STRIKES ONCE AGAIN! Full outside off, angling away, Hafeez looks to drive away from his body but ends up outside edging it. Wade dives low to his right and grabs the ball. Good catch there! Not a good comeback game with the bat for Hafeez! AUSTRALIA NEED 8 WICKETS MORE TO WIN, while PAKISTAN NEED 222 MORE FROM 239 BALLS!
POWERPLAY 2 has been signalled. Four fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Short and outside off, cut through point for a boundary!

Full on middle, Mohammad flicks it uppishly over mid-wicket. The ball almost reaches the fence but James Faulkner races to his left and dives to stop the ball, pushing it away from the ropes. Three runs taken.
WIDE. A short ball, banged in the middle of the pitch, Hafeez ducks. Actually he did not need to. That was so high Pakistan would have needed two Hafeezs to reach that.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, driven straight back but Cummins does well to stop it.
Landed around off, watchfully defended.
What happened there? Faulkner was walking off, thinking he has finished his over. Umpire Shamshuddin also started to give the bowler his cap back but suddenly realized a ball was pending.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Azhar Ali is not feeling too well. He is limping off the field. BABAR AZAM walks in at number 4, replacing Azhar.
Short and outside off, Hafeez punches it through the covers. Azhar limps across while crossing over to the other end.
One more leave outside off.
Outside off, left alone.
MOHAMMAD HAFEEZ walks in at number 3, replacing Sharjeel.

OUT! Caught! Sharjeel throws it away. Well, not really though. That is the way he plays. Full on middle, Sharjeel looks to go over the top but mistimes it towards mid on. Glenn Maxwell takes it calmly. Faulkner gives him an unnecessary send-off. Spare him, mate. He just got hit on the head a few minutes back. 231 NEEDED FROM 251 BALLS.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Shortish in length outside off, Azhar arches his back and tries to play the cut but misses.
On a good length outside off, played straight to point.
Finally... Azhar is ready and good to go. Not to the dressing room. But to play.
Oh dear.... another one is down. Azhar Ali seems to have hurt his hamstring while taking the second. The physio is out in the middle.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
WIDE. Short and wide outside off, Ali backs away and then tries to slash but misses.
On a good length around off, pushed towards mid on.
A short ball outside off, Azhar leaps and tries to cut but mistimes it towards point.
Double change. PAT CUMMINS comes on to bowl.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, SK looks to drive but misses. No feet movement.
FOUR! He has not got his length right, Faulkner. Lands this full again, on the pads, Sharjeel just whips it over mid-wicket and gets a boundary!
Outside off, played through point for a run.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and around off, swinging in, pushed towards mid on.
As expected, Stanlake goes off the field. Usman Khawaja comes in his place. Meanwhile, Smith does a bowling change - JAMES FAULKNER comes on to bowl.
Good finish to the over, full on middle, pushed towards mid on. 11 from the over.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

The twelfth man comes out with the helmet but Sharjeel says he is fine and asks him to stay where he is. Meanwhile, Stanlake wants a drinks now and is on his haunches. He is shaking his head. This does not look good. The physio is out in the middle. So Sharjeel automatically now replaces his helmet. Both players are okay now.

OUCH! ON THE HELMET! That is a sharp ball. A bouncer on middle, SK ducks, taking his eyes off the ball and nearly plays the price. But the ball hits him on his helmet and goes to third man. The batsmen take a single. Hopefully, he is okay.
Full on middle and off, flicked through mid-wicket. Pat Cummins covers good ground to his left from fine leg to stop the ball but still ends up giving three runs.
A short ball again, pulled straight to Starc at deep backward square leg for a single.

SIX! There comes the Jayasuriya flick! Terrific shot. A short ball on middle, Sharjeel just plays the pick-up pull and gets it over square leg. Mitchell Starc settles himself for the catch but then goes beyond the ropes. Still leaps and tries to take it but drops it.
That is an excellent piece of fielding. Khan works it towards mid on or rather wide of him. But Pat Cummins throws himself to his left and stops the ball. Just a single.
Short and outside off, punched on the bounce to cover-point.
Another change in the field. Fine leg goes back and square leg comes in.
Full and outside off, this is eased through the covers for another brace.
Mitchell Marsh moves from first slip to short mid-wicket now.
Finally gets bat on ball with his swing and chips it over mid-wicket. Does not have enough on it and James Faulkner stops it in the deep, running to his right. Two runs taken.
Full on middle, driven straight to mid on.

That has missed everything. Starc bowls this around off, gets it to nip back in, Sharjeel tries to work it to the leg side but he is almost cut into half in the attempt. The ball somehow misses the stumps.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Down the leg side, flicked away for a single.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads.

On a good length around middle and leg, SK looks to play the pick-up pull, similar to how the great Sanath Jayasuriya used to play. The intention was good, the execution wasn't. The ball hits his pads and went back to the bowler.
WIDE. Slips this down the leg side, Khan misses his flick again and this time the ball goes past his bat.
On middle and off, defended back to the bowler.

A full ball down the leg side, Sharjeel misses his tuck and the ball deflects off his pads behind. But Matthew Wade flies to his right like a cheetah and stops it. Well, cheetahs do not fly but hope you get what I mean. Stopped a certain boundary there. Seems like the health drink is working.
Seems like Wade is suffering from cramps. He batted for two-and-a-half hours and is limping a touch right now. Usman Khawaja comes out with a health drink.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
FOUR BYES! That flew! A short ball outside off, Azhar looks to cut but the ball bounces all of a sudden and flies over the keeper to the third man fence! Everyone are surprised and are all smiles.
Full and outside off, Azhar drives it wide of mid off and David Warner gives it a chase. Keeps the batsmen to a couple.
Landed outside off, fuller in length, AA pushes at it and almost nicks it behind.
WIDE. A short ball but down the leg side, Ali lets it through.
Full and outside off, Azhar leans and drives it between cover and point for a couple.
Full on middle, swinging in, pushed straight to mid on.
Short and wide outside off, Ali flays at it and gets it off the outside edge to third man. A single taken.
Short in length, played straight to point.
Landed outside off, an on a length, left alone.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Short and wide outside off, Azhar has a flash but misses. That ball moved late after pitching.
Landed outside off, left alone.
BILLY STANLAKE to bowl with the other new ball.
Full and angling in, Sharjeel looks to flick but misses and gets hit low on the pads.

Interesting piece of commentary from Mark Taylor on air. He mentions that the end from where Starc is bowling, he is running in from the sun into the shade where Sharjeel or Azhar are batting. Difficult to adjust.
Fuller on the pads, tickled round the corner. But, there is a short fine leg in place so no runs taken.
Full around off, Ali looks to drive it on the up but the ball swings away a touch and gets off the outside edge past the slip cordon for a single. Off the mark with that and so is Pakistan!
Wide outside off, Ali shoulders his arms through.
Full outside off, Azhar kneels and punches it to covers.
Angling across AA, he leaves it.

Out come the Pakistani openers, Azhar Ali and Sharjeel Khan. They will be looking to survive the initial spell and build a strong platform upfront. Mitchell Starc has the ball in his hand. Here we go...

Welcome back ladies and gentlemen for the chase. The Australian fielders are on the field. They will be buoyed after the fight shown by their batsmen to post a challenging total and would like to take the momentum into their bowling.
